title: AI-generated political ads are showing up on TV screens, experts say they are getting harder to spot
hook_text: AI political ads hit TV screens.
script:
AI political ads are hitting television screens.
KSAT reports that synthetic commercials are getting much harder to spot.
Political campaigns are using generative video tools to produce spots without filming actors.
Viewers face digital avatars and manipulated audio during standard commercial breaks.
Modern tools create fabricated speech and scenes in seconds.
Can you spot a fake ad?
